items.text: CozoDB embedded as elohim-storage dep (sqlite/sled backend, separate file); RUSTFLAGS= cargo build --release clean; graph-disabled config flag escape hatch
Core graph schema (relations epr_node/epr_edge/epr_lamad/epr_shefa/epr_qahal + universal indexes + traversal primitives neighborhood/path/reach_filtered/version_chain) created idempotently at startup
HNSW vector slot declared on epr_node.embedding <F32;768> (embedding pipeline deferred; near-zero cost unused)
Validity bitemporal type used throughout (updated_at, asserted_at) for first-class time-travel/version queries

Manifest extension contract: app-manifest.schema.json gains top-level graph section (edges/nodes/indexes/rules) + registration-time validator (unique types, valid refs, no core-rule shadowing, Datalog parses)

Projection pipeline: projector fans out to both diesel and CozoDB from same event source; per-target transactional, cross-target eventually-consistent; upsert-by-CID idempotent; forward-tolerance of missing edge targets

Backfill command projector::backfill_graph: walks epr_atoms in CID order, re-derives graph projection, CID-watermark checkpoint, idempotent; runs at first startup / schema migration / reconciliation divergence
Lamad manifest extension (rides along): edges PREREQUISITE/TEACHES/CONTAINS/REFERENCES/MASTERY_OF/SUPERSEDES + rules prerequisite_chain/mastery_frontier

9 view builders: 3 lamad (resolved_atom, navigation_context, atom_version_chain) + 6 shefa (peer_topology, reciprocity, cluster, resilience_snapshot, distribution, topology_overview); graph-backed composing Datalog + diesel
4 new REST view schemas + routes: resolved-atom, navigation-context, atom-version-chain, topology-overview; 5 existing schemas gain graph backing (wire shape unchanged)

GraphQL surface (server-side): async-graphql at POST /api/v1/graphql; codegen pass emits Apollo Federation v2 subgraph SDL; default+pillar resolvers; LearningNeighborhood + HouseholdTopology demo queries return expected shape
No regressions: existing storage tests pass; existing REST views unchanged in wire shape; no new DHT entry types; pre-push + orchestrator CI green

Deferred: embedding pipeline (model/cadence/refresh); per-rule cost annotation; custom resolvers in domain manifests; graph projection observability; CozoDB query-optimization tooling; Angular Apollo Client wiring; @wip BDD lift (frontend follow-on)
